bounds: One fixed terminal restore and immutable S0 attempt, one counted slot, two concurrent trusted coordinator turns and two node occurrences.
limitations: One-shot Docker creation may finish after lease expiry and tombstone. Exact ID or producer quiescence is required before proof.
Database settlement is atomic. Provider receipt validity, SSH authentication, cryptographic digests and immutable source authority are assumptions exercised separately by integration tests.
The original operation stays terminal. The conditional liveness property does not cover unavailable/reincarnated nodes or an unresponsive provider.

assumptions: Checked formula in exact_restore_recovery: StableAuthorityCleanupFinishes = (always(s.currentNode == 1) and producerQuiescent.weakFair(s) and workers.forall(w => begin(w, 1).weakFair(s) and tombstone(w).weakFair(s) and observeExactId(w).weakFair(s) and deleteExactId(w).weakFair(s) and receiveProof(w).weakFair(s) and settle(w).weakFair(s))).implies(eventually(s.receipt))
The property is conditional on its written model fairness and environmental premises. Real scheduler fairness, provider completion and implementation refinement are not proved.

fairness: Cleanup completion assumes a stable original node incarnation, eventual producer quiescence, and weak fairness for trusted begin, tombstone, observation, exact deletion, proof and settlement actions. Unavailable authority remains quarantined.
